title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Many IDA-stabilized Ln-Ni clusters form tunable n × m × l parallelepiped frameworks whose edges are built by repeating triangular {LnNi3} units.
explanation: Motifs taken from known structures such as Ln52Ni56 and Ln60Ni76, especially {LnNi3}, are treated as Lego-like blocks. Reported members include 3×3×3, 5×3×3, 5×5×3, 5×5×5, 7×3×3, and 7×7×7 families, with internal and external sizes in Table 2. HRESI-MS is used to find conditions under which the blocks form.
conditions: Identification of recurring blocks from crystal structures, then assembly; auxiliary anions or ligands differ by entry in Table 2.
caveats: Fig. 5 marks some predicted n × m × l topologies as not yet found. Auxiliary ligands change nuclearity even within the same nominal topology.
